about: The joined world on world.html (since 2026-10-12 evening its default is all eight sections, S7 to S1): walks.json gathers the sections' own walks and their joined walks (each section's seam-edge walks dropped, since the walls between joined sections come down; a few starts moved where a walker paces the way in, or a boat under way's phase decides the end: see each walk's why) plus walks across the seams; it runs on the default URL with goto() per walk.
